metas.name: MELANIA the Series
metas.description: Experience Melania Trump's transition to First Lady as she navigates the White House and puts her mission into action.

metas.name: Friz i Wersow. W drodze
metas.description: The production will follow Friz and Wersow as they embark on a new chapter in their lives—as parents of two children, business partners, and a couple ready to confront previously untold aspects of their own story. The six-part documentary series will premiere exclusively on Prime Video later this year.

metas.name: Koba LaD : Demain j'arrête
metas.description: Through archive footage and accounts from people close to him, this documentary series follows French rapper Koba LaD from his beginnings in Évry to his breakthrough in music. It explores the contrasts between his public success, his personal life and the legal troubles that led to his imprisonment.

metas.name: Rock, Paper, Landmines
metas.description: Glico, Daruma-san ga Koronda... A game everyone knows—transformed into the ultimate battle of wits!?

metas.name: Devils' Crest
metas.description: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

metas.name: Campus Drivers
metas.description: Lois arrives in Belrose with Max, the love of her life. Lane, the creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, is known for never getting attached. Their paths were never meant to cross. But some encounters change everything, reopening old wounds. And when love appears unexpectedly, nothing is certain anymore.

metas.name: Lo invisible
metas.description: *Lo Invisible* explores the lesser-known reality of five elite athletes, uncovering the hard work, routines, and sacrifices that make the major victories witnessed by the public possible. Through an intimate look at their lives, the series seeks to find the link between performance optimization and the deeply human side of these athletes—revealing where success is truly built.

metas.name: Seks, Zweet en Tranen
metas.description: Behind all the photos, videos, and fantasies lies a world that normally remains hidden. But behind every exciting image, there is also simply a workday…

metas.name: The Greatest
metas.description: Fresh off gold at the 1960 Olympics, young boxer Muhammad Ali (then known as Cassius Clay) sets his sights on the Heavyweight Championship. Contending with newfound fame, self-doubt, family conflict and a politically charged America, the once-in-a-generation prodigy discovers his greatest opponent won't be in the ring, but in a society that isn't ready for him to become his own man.

metas.name: The Traitor Within
metas.description: The series follows the young and ambitious Henry Rinnan, and how his personal demons and narcissistic need for recognition drove him from a failed salesman to Norway’s most notorious traitor.

metas.name: El Marqués 1985
metas.description: 1985. Eight years after the investigation into the crimes at the farmhouse, Onofre has become a crime reporter. At the newsroom, two women—Carmen and Concepción—entrust him with investigating the disappearance of their brother, Nani—a wanted criminal who had been taken into custody and whom they suspect was killed by the police officers who interrogated him.

metas.name: LOL: Last One Laughing Halloween UK
metas.description: Last One Laughing is back…with a twist. Jimmy Carr is joined by 7 of the country's funniest people for a special Halloween-themed series and this time, there's no laughing OR screaming. Over the course of 4 hours, they will pull out all the stops to make each other crack…but who will last longest and take home the trophy?

metas.name: LOL: Last One Laughing Québec - Halloween Special
metas.description: Patrick Huard invites eight iconic TV hosts to face off in a haunted edition of the ultimate comedy experience. One haunted mansion, eight hosts, and three hours to make each other laugh, all while resisting the urge to laugh themselves. With a whole host of spooky tricks and treats in store, will the screams overtake the laughter?

metas.name: LOL: Chi ride è fuori - Halloween Special
metas.description: Six much-loved contestants from previous editions of LOL face off in a spooky studio, where they must not only resist laughing but also avoid being frightened. From the Control Room, the members of Gialappa's Band deliver relentless commentary, accompanied by Lillo.

metas.name: Chaar Yaar
metas.description: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

metas.name: R91
metas.description: The aircraft carrier *Charles de Gaulle* has just set sail for a strategic mission in the Eastern Mediterranean, a region where the situation is volatile. Shortly after departure, however, a female crew member is found dead and another is reported missing. Despite the danger, the operation continues, and a military investigator is urgently dispatched on board. When a new victim is discovered, the *Charles*—a veritable floating city of 1,800 men and 240 women—turns into a trap where a killer, mounting tensions, and unfolding events threaten the crew and perhaps even the country itself.

metas.name: Love Transit 35+
metas.description: Love gets more complicated with age, and that's exactly what makes it so dramatic! A new season of Love Transit kicks off with a cast of men and women aged 35 and older. For the first time in the series, a former married couple will also take part. Ten people, each with unexpected secrets from their romantic past, face life-changing decisions that can't be made based on love alone.

metas.name: LOL: Last One Laughing Netherlands - Halloween Special
metas.description: Just in time for Halloween, Philippe and Jeroom return with a spine-tingling LOL special. Ten celebrities will face off in teams of two, battling the ultimate challenge: staying completely straight-faced for four hours. But this time, it's not just about holding back laughter-fear is off-limits too.

metas.name: The Stepback with Blake Griffin
metas.description: A bold new series where late-night comedy collides with the hottest sports debates. Each week, Griffin goes beyond the box score — tackling sports betting, hot-take culture, athlete empowerment, and viral moments with the wit only a veteran player and superfan can bring. This is sports for the internet generation.

metas.name: SOR
metas.description: In the series SOR, every patient represents a unique story, and successive shifts demonstrate that no two cases in the ER are alike. Patients admitted to the hospital will include, for instance, a critically injured motorcyclist whose condition fails to improve despite standard procedures; doctors and paramedics will also fight to save the life of a well-known TV presenter, while teenagers involved in a serious electric scooter accident will also arrive at the unit. A major test for the entire team will be a bus crash that places the ER on high alert. A large number of critically injured patients will arrive simultaneously, forcing doctors to make split-second decisions on which lives depend.

metas.name: The Brain
metas.description: Divided into two teams, Alpha and Beta, former reality TV stars face unexpected test of general knowledge and reasoning under pressure. Amid rivalries, alliances, strategy and humor, the contestants have to show their abilities to survive until the end and become The Greatest Brain of Reality TV.

metas.name: The Threads of Fear
metas.description: The Threads of Fear is a psychological thriller miniseries that turns everyday situations into unsettling and disturbing experiences. Across eight episodes, it explores how fear can emerge in the most unexpected places, transforming the familiar into a true nightmare.

metas.name: Hometown Giants
metas.description: Step inside the Vancouver Giants major junior hockey team, where celebrity owners Michael Bublé and Drew Scott set out to revive a franchise that hasn't won a championship since 2007. For the players, they're teenagers living away from home, finishing high school, and chasing NHL dreams they've built their lives around, even though only a few will ever make it.

metas.name: Friends Sex and Games
metas.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

metas.name: Marília Mendonça: All the Feels
metas.description: How did an ordinary girl from the heart of Brazil become a phenomenon? Through previously unreleased footage, audio recordings and interviews, the series traces Marília Mendonça's meteoric rise from singing at a gas station to becoming one of Brazil's biggest artists.

metas.name: The Traitors (Telugu)
metas.description: Twenty contestants play the ultimate game of trust and betrayal.

metas.name: Les Fous du bus
metas.description: "Les Fous du Bus" is a wild road trip through France, led by Ahmed Sylla and accompanied by six of the most promising comedians of their generation: Blandine Lehout, Emy BNG, Sofia Belabbes, Édouard Deloignon, Julien Santini, and Umut Koker. While they are well-accustomed to comedy clubs and the stages of Paris, this time they will have to step well outside their comfort zones.

metas.name: Mírame así, el camino de Noa
metas.description: Noa visits her boyfriend in Argentina, where she meets Tomy. As she explores her musical identity under parental pressure, Tomy tries to leave his musical past behind while both navigate life in Buenos Aires.

metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

metas.name: Oishii no Tsukurikata
metas.description: A story of family bonds and renewal forged through food, brought to you by the *Solitary Gourmet* (Kodoku no Gourmet) production team.

metas.name: I Would Rather Die
metas.description: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

metas.name: Paul
metas.description: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…

metas.name: Kill Jackie
metas.description: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

metas.name: Traffic Jam
metas.description: A massive traffic jam brings together a diverse group of stranded motorists, from troubled couples and families to nuns and thieves. As tensions rise and unexpected connections form, the gridlock becomes the setting for a series of comic and heartfelt stories.

metas.name: Special Branch
metas.description: When a young doctor is raped and murdered inside a prestigious medical college, ACP Damini Sengupta uncovers a web of corruption, cover-ups, and political influence. As witnesses disappear and evidence vanishes, she and her Special Branch team risk everything to expose the truth and deliver justice against a system determined to bury it.

metas.name: Prohibida Obsesión
metas.description: A single night can change everything. Luciano’s perfect life begins to crumble after a night of passion with Bárbara, as she draws ever closer to his circle of friends.

metas.name: No Signal
metas.description: Eight influencers accustomed to showcasing an idyllic life on social media attend a transformative retreat to get to know themselves better. What lies behind the perfect life they project?

metas.name: Girls of Warsaw
metas.description: A documentary series that offers a behind-the-scenes look at the lives of some of Poland's most popular female influencers.

metas.name: Cathedrals
metas.description: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

metas.name: Neagley
metas.description: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

metas.name: Pranked by Melvin
metas.description: Melvin Kakooza goes undercover to surprise and celebrate his friends with spectacular, affectionately staged pranks. With the help of friends and family, he turns the classic prank genre on its head, putting humor, friendship, and big surprises center stage.

metas.name: Isabel Raad: Behind the Curtains
metas.description: A powerful and unique series about one of Norway's most successful influencers, Isabel Raad. After four years of being single, she can feel her biological clock ticking. One impulsive text message to her ex changes everything. We follow Isabel through love and crises in an intimate story about family, trauma, and hope. For the first time, the series reveals who her dream man is, and how they met.

metas.name: Honor Thy Mother
metas.description: After years of estrangement, a mother and daughter find themselves on opposite sides of a bitter contest for what each believes is rightfully hers. Old wounds resurface as they weigh whether to confront the past together or let it drive them further apart.

metas.name: The Trial
metas.description: A teenager and her father struggle for justice after she is sexually assaulted by the scion of a successful businessman. Not only will the father and daughter have to navigate a failed judicial system, but they must also contend with a wealthy adversary bent on using all his power to protect his son.

metas.name: The Revolutionaries
metas.description: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

metas.name: LOL Next
metas.description: Spin-off of the hit series "LOL: Last One Laughing", hosted by Hazel Brugger.

metas.name: Live better for less
metas.description: Across seven European countries, seven hosts help households with big goals: decluttering, selling what they no longer need, and building habits that move them forward. From overflowing closets to forgotten sheds, the series reveals just how similar our problems are across Europe and offers tips and tricks for living better for less.

metas.name: Coração de Mãe
metas.description: “Coração de Mãe” is the story of Linda—an ordinary woman and a true warrior—who struggles to save her loved ones from a violent man. Faced with an inevitable transformation, she realizes there is no turning back: she must discover a way to change her life before it is too late.

metas.name: The Grand Tour
metas.description: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

metas.name: Jagamae Sangeetham
metas.description: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

metas.name: Dolore e Psiche
metas.description: *Dolore e Psiche* is a series that explores mental health through real-life locations, stories, and personal accounts. Ale meets patients, doctors, and healthcare professionals in specialized centers, hospital wards, secure psychiatric units (REMS), and rehabilitation communities, delving into various forms of mental distress and addiction. It is a journey—both human and educational—that moves beyond stigma, prejudice, and oversimplification.

metas.name: Les Fumiers: Welcome to the Farm
metas.description: Eight content creators leave their daily lives and comfort behind to take on a challenge set by four French farms: confronting the reality of agricultural life. Their mission: work hard, push their limits, and be the top performer to raise as much money as possible for their charity. Who will best adapt to this new life and win this unprecedented adventure?

metas.name: Meet the Owens
metas.description: Forget everything you think you know about Michael Owen. This is an action-packed and unexpectedly hilarious year in the life of the footballer-turned-Horse-Racing-Stable-owner & his famous family. Michael juggles a business on the edge with a chaotic home life, while daughter Gemma swaps social media for the saddle to become a jockey. Funny, warm… and far from boring.

metas.name: Oracles & Prophets
metas.description: historic figures or sacred sites believed to share messages from a deity or see the future. An oracle is often a shrine or the priestess who speaks riddles from a god (like the Oracle at Delphi), while a prophet is a person who delivers a direct divine message or call for moral change.

metas.name: A Beautiful Obsession
metas.description: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

metas.name: An Amputation Obsession: The Monster and the Surgeon
metas.description: Vascular surgeon Neil Hopper becomes a symbol of hope after losing both legs, until an investigation uncovers a hidden obsession and secret life.

metas.name: Castle Walls
metas.description: In the eleventh century, Hasan Sabbah captures the castle of Alamut and founds a mysterious movement that challenges the established order. While his old friend Nizam al-Mulk strives to protect the empire, Azazil—a warrior freed from the dungeon—emerges as his most loyal *fedai*. In this tale where friendship turns to enmity, love, faith, betrayal, and the lust for power fuel a conflict that alters the course of history.

metas.name: The Chosen in the Wild with Bear Grylls
metas.description: Follows Grylls as he takes the cast of The Chosen, as well as series creator Dallas Jenkins, on adventures in the wilderness.

metas.name: Gladiators - Die Show der Giganten
metas.description: "Gladiators – The Show of Giants," hosted by Laura Wontorra and Jan Köppen with commentary by Frank Buschmann, is a spectacular test of strength in which 17 gladiators face off against formidable professionals in action-packed games! Who will be crowned the Gladiators champion?

metas.name: Sterling Point
metas.description: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

metas.name: BEAUTY BATTLE ROYALE: Japan-Korea Next-Generation Makeup Artist Championship
Bayrak Taşıyanlar
metas.description: The success stories of 4 Turkish national athletes who have etched their names in the minds of the world.

metas.name: Warota!
metas.description:
It is a sketch comedy series starring SixTONES, marking the group’s first attempt at comedy as a unit. The show features a range of formats, including situational sketches, short skits, and serialized comedy segments, all performed on full-scale, professionally designed sets.

In each episode, SixTONES collaborate with guest actors and emerging creators, taking on various scripts and creative directions. Through these performances, the members showcase their distinct personalities as they engage in dynamic and often chaotic comedic interactions. The series offers a unique side of SixTONES that is exclusive to this program.

metas.name: Fatal First Dates
metas.description: Fatal First Dates explores real cases where online dating and first meetings end in tragedy, revealing how trust, deception and modern technology can turn romance into danger.

metas.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
metas.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

metas.name: Cyborg 009 Nemesis
metas.description: Since their inception, the cyborg soldiers have protected humanity from various enemies threatening peace for over half a century. Yet the battle continues—a group of nine cyborgs called "Nemesis" convinced that 009 and his comrades alone cannot bring peace to the world has emerged. Led by Graviton, the cyborg who manipulates gravity, what is their ultimate goal? Will we witness a generational change!?

metas.name: Super Market
metas.description: Super Market is the new Italian Prime Original comedy series written and directed by the Il Terzo Segreto di Satira collective, following the tragicomic events of Eury, a chaotic neighborhood supermarket facing closure

metas.name: Undercover Lover
metas.description: 14 seemingly single men and women arrive at a stunning villa, but 5 are secretly in relationships. From a second villa, their partners watch as they try to keep their romance hidden. When sparks fly from the start, jealousy and distrust quickly create tension

metas.name: Young Farts Trailer Parts
metas.description: Small-town brothers Jagger and Dawson run Young Farts RV Parts, a multi-million-dollar business where they turn trailer trash into cash. Between outrageous schemes, chaotic stunts, and big-hearted hijinks, these brothers chase one wild idea after the next - all for the love of their family and the empire they’re building.

metas.name: The Criminal
metas.description: A random mass stabbing, major food company Titus Foods, and a mysterious infant disease. These three things have as much in common as Detective Soma, hack writer Yarimizu, and the stabbing's lone survivor, Shuji. Yet, these men are now embroiled in a risky quest for the truth. What they find, though, is more heinous than they imagined, making them question just who is the real criminal?

metas.name: Qesma w Naseeb: Al-Aroos w Al-Hamat
POTENTIAL "Tadayoshi Ohkura"
metas.description: Super Eight's Tadayoshi Ohkura has spent 22 years on stage. Now he channels that experience into mentoring 150+ trainees in this intimate documentary.

metas.name: Ride or Die
metas.description: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

metas.name: Murder 101
metas.description: Part teen drama, part masterclass, and part edge-of-your-seat crime investigation, follow a high school sociology class in rural Tennessee who help revive a decades-old case into a present-day hunt for a killer.

metas.name: La feria
metas.description: In the days leading up to the start of the April Fair, Marina, Natalia, Manu, and Carlos prepare to experience the most important week of the year. As they finalize preparations for the *Pescaíto* and juggle their commitments as content creators, both excitement and insecurities surface.

metas.name: The Loyalty Game
metas.description: A group of women runs a unique business: luring men to expose their infidelity. Their newest client, Ana, lives a seemingly perfect life with her devoted husband-until doubt creeps in. As he starts to distort her reality, Ana teams up with a loyalty tester, and their search for truth spirals into a dangerous game of secrets, manipulation, and power-where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

metas.name: Isakapatnam
metas.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

metas.name: Elle
metas.description: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

metas.name: Kraken: The Black Book of Hours
metas.description: A crime series based on the bestseller *The Black Book of Hours* by Eva García Sáenz de Urturi. Kraken receives a mysterious phone call ordering him to track down a rare, valuable book; if he fails, his mother will be killed. The problem, however, is that his mother has been dead for decades. Together with his inseparable partner Esti, he must solve a complex case filled with suspense, action, and emotion.

metas.name: Alliance
metas.description: A competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points-the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

metas.name: What Would You Rather?: Decide to Survive
metas.description: Romesh Ranganathan hosts ten UK online stars playing Would You Rather for real. Fiendish dilemmas decide everything, from hilarious supersized games to how they eat and sleep. There's no right decision, but making the least worst choice could guarantee survival (in the game, not literally). You've played it hypothetically, now they're playing it for real, and only one will be crowned champion.

metas.name: Would You Rather: Decide to Survive
metas.description: Would You Rather be invisible or be able to fly? Fight one giant duck or 1000 tiny ducks? Eat a man-sized bean or a bean-sized man? This comedy game show will see two teams of some of Britain's funniest digital personalities compete in hilarious real-life challenges based on classic hypothetical Would You Rather decisions. These three simple words decide everything from what they eat to who they send home.

metas.name: Ab Hoga Hisaab
metas.description: Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

metas.name: Sidemen Presents: Side-Menu
metas.description: The Sidemen are joined by a guest contestant as they take on a series of culinary challenges – a starter, main and dessert – with teams rotating every episode and individual points on the line.

metas.name: Chloe et Emma
metas.description: Having lost love, her job, and her home, Emma had hit rock bottom when she stumbled upon the estate of Chloe, a mysterious heiress. Unexpected happenings lead the two of them to become housemates, and together, they open a fortune-telling shop where troubled souls come searching for answers. The pair soon realize that each client's problem comes with hidden secrets and mysteries.

metas.name: Raakh
metas.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

metas.name: Every Year After
metas.description: Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

metas.name: The Ultimate Rider
metas.description: The Ultimate Rider is a high-performance reality series built to find the next professional motocross athlete. Sixteen riders. Two weeks. No outside contact. No second chances. Through relentless training, competition, and pressure, riders are pushed to their limits—physically, mentally, and emotionally. There are no eliminations. Only performance. Only progression. At the end, one rider earns a contract—and a future in professional motocross.

metas.name: Ticket to the Tribes
metas.description: In the new reality show, 12 Dutch and Flemish celebrities live together with the Himba community in Namibia. This means that the participants must live without modern amenities and adapt to the tribe's way of life. The participants are judged on their commitment and respect for the culture. The celebrities who adapt the least are eliminated. Ultimately, one participant remains. This person is appointed an honorary member by the community.

metas.name: The Pyramid Scheme
metas.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

metas.name: Patrocínio
metas.description: In a world dominated by filters and controlled narratives, "Patrocinio" breaks with the formality of one of Portugal's most influential families to offer an intimate and unprecedented access to the sisters' world. The camera ceases to be a guest at gala events and instead portrays the emotional, professional, and familial structure that sustains an empire of influence, work, and sisterhood.

metas.name: L'Affaire Céline Giboire - une contre-enquête de McSkyz
metas.description: On February 28, 2012, the body of 16-year-old Céline Giboire was found at the foot of a cliff in the Corbières park in Saint-Malo. Since then, her family has rejected the suicide theory put forward by the authorities and has fought to uncover the truth about the circumstances of her death. McSkyz revisits the case in an attempt to understand what happened to Céline.

metas.name: The 50
metas.description: Tension and strategy, clashes and provocations, but also fun, relationships and friendships, are the ingredients of The 50, the new reality game in which 50 of the most popular Italian celebrities and influencers will compete in a series of tests.

metas.name: Beating the Odds
metas.description: BEATing The Odds: BEAT is charting a new course. After a winless streak, the team has decided to make a change. With a new structure and renewed ambition, the quest for improvement begins. But in a sport where every detail matters, the question is: is this enough to truly break through?

metas.name: Offline med Isa & Tilda
metas.description: In the first season of OFFLINE, Isa and Tilda leave the big city, screens and likes. Stureplan is exchanged for a farm, TikTok for tractors and high heels for rubber boots. No mobile, no champagne, no shopping - just cows, chaos and total shock. Laughter, tears, anger and frustration. Patience and friendship are put to the test. It's iconic, crazy and unforgettable. A season you don't want to miss!

metas.name: EXAM
metas.description: A determined young woman with a mysterious past enters the dangerous world of the Regional Public Service Exam (RPSE) scam to expose a powerful paper-leak network. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a corruption chain embedded deep within the education system-and must bring it down before it destroys the dreams of an entire generation.

metas.name: Off Campus
metas.description: Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.

metas.description: Tomatometer 55%

metas.name: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
metas.description: Tomatometer 94%

metas.description: Tomatometer 72%

A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
metas.description: Tomatometer 85%

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
The Real Housewives of New York City
